title: Kuwait-flagged tanker hit in Strait of Hormuz, fire reported
excerpt: A Kuwait-flagged VLCC was struck in the Strait of Hormuz, the second attack on a Kuwait Oil Tanker Company vessel in four days, as UKMTO reports more tanker incidents.
